result.description:
Quality Australian manufacturing is in our DNA. We have been manufacturing boots, accessories and hardwearing apparel in Adelaide since our inception in 1932.

Position Summary
We are seeking Full-Time employees to join our Apparel & Craft Team at our Workshop in Salisbury, Adelaide. As part of our Apparel & Craft department, you will be responsible for supporting our production lines in producing quality clothing/craft product and gaining an understanding of our products and processes.

We are looking for individuals who are enthusiastic, task orientated and reliable. You will need to be good with your hands, ready to learn and have a good attitude to work.

Key Responsibilities
Consistently achieve production KPIs while maintaining high-quality standards.
Collaborate effectively with team members to meet production goals.
Adhere to all safe work procedures and ensure compliance with workplace safety standards.
Maintain a clean and organized working environment, including performing general housekeeping duties.
Operate an automatic cutting machine efficiently and safely.
Monitor the quality of fabric and cutting work, promptly addressing any issues.

Skills and Experience
Prior experience operating sewing machines is essential.
Familiarity with production or manufacturing environments is highly desirable.
Ability to work effectively in a team and follow reasonable directions.
Exceptional attention to detail, coupled with a strong work ethic.
Reliable, punctual, and flexible, with the willingness to work overtime as needed.

What We Offer
Long-term career opportunities
On-the-job training
40% employee discount
Discount private health insurance
Paid Parental Leave
On-site canteen
Employee rewards and benefits
As part of the selection process, applicants must be prepared to undergo a pre-employment medical examination, including functional, audiometric, vision, drug, and alcohol testing.

About Us
Since 1932, we have answered a call for hardwearing, timeless products that can hold up against the harsh conditions of the Australian outback - and look good whilst doing it. Our bestselling leather boots and belts are still crafted by hand in Adelaide, South Australia, alongside an ever-growing range of apparel, accessories and lifestyle products. At the heart of everything we do is a simple promise of loyalty and endurance; a commitment that our products will accompany their wearer on all of life’s great journeys. Reginald Murray ‘RM’ Williams always said, ‘it’s the people who make a company’ and we stand by that statement today, with a global network of teams that feels like family. A culture of growth, development and team spirit is central to our success.

The position supports to the engineering delivery of wireless network deployments involving major mobile operators such as Telstra, Optus and Vodafone, supporting integration, validation and technical documentation activities across indoor and macro network projects.   Benefits   Competitive salary aligned with skills and industry experience.  Opportunity to contribute to RF, DAS and wireless network projects across major Australian carrier environments (Telstra, Optus and Vodafone).  Exposure to interstate telecommunications deployments and multi-site engineering activities.  Ongoing professional development within a specialised telecommunications engineering team.    Task & responsibilities   Contribute to the integration, optimisation and performance monitoring of telecommunications network systems across RF and in-building wireless environments.  Support testing, commissioning and validation of 4G, 5G and legacy cellular technologies to ensure network performance targets are achieved.  Conduct RF performance analysis and contribute to troubleshooting activities under engineering supervision.  Prepare technical documentation, site records and engineering reports in line with Australian standards and project requirements.  Collaborate with project engineers, vendors and field technicians to maintain network reliability, compliance and service quality.  Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to network performance and system optimisation.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering or related discipline.  3+ years of hands-on experience in telecommunications network engineering, including RF systems and in-building coverage environments.   Demonstrated application of telecommunications engineering principles including system integration, performance evaluation and network optimisation within carrier-grade environments.  Proven experience in telecommunications network engineering within RF and in-building environments.  Strong knowledge of LTE (4G), 5G NR and Wi-Fi, with understanding of legacy cellular technologies.  Experience with In-Building Coverage (IBC), repeater systems and Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS).  Experience using RF performance analysis and data collection tools such as TEMS, NEMO and GIS/RF planning tools (MapInfo, iBwave or similar).  Proficiency with RF test and measurement equipment, including spectrum analysers, RF scanners, RF signal generators, and cable and antenna testing equipment.  Demonstrated application of RF engineering principles including link budget calculations and system performance evaluation.  Ability to produce technical documentation using engineering design tools (Visio or similar).   About Company     Entelso Pty Ltd is an Australian telecommunications solutions provider specialising in network design, RF engineering and in-building coverage solutions across carrier and enterprise environments. We design and implement wireless connectivity solutions supporting major Australian mobile network operators including Telstra, Optus and Vodafone,   delivered through established supply chain partners.    The company provides nationwide delivery capability across telecommunications infrastructure projects, including Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS), repeater technologies and network optimisation solutions.
